import os
import pytest
from app import app, init_db, get_db

TEST_DB = "test_tasks.db"


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def setup_db():
    os.environ["DATABASE"] = TEST_DB
    init_db()
    yield
    if os.path.exists(TEST_DB):
        os.remove(TEST_DB)


@pytest.fixture
def client():
    app.config["TESTING"] = True
    return app.test_client()


def test_create_task_missing_title(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={})
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert resp.json["error"] == "title is required"

    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": ""})
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert resp.json["error"] == "title is required"

    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "   "})
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert resp.json["error"] == "title is required"


def test_create_task_success(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Buy groceries"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json
    assert data["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert data["status"] == "pending"
    assert "id" in data
    assert "created_at" in data


def test_list_tasks_empty(client):
    resp = client.get("/tasks")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json == []


def test_list_tasks_ordered(client):
    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Task 1"})
    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Task 2"})
    client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Task 3"})
    resp = client.get("/tasks")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    tasks = resp.json
    assert len(tasks) == 3
    titles = [t["title"] for t in tasks]
    assert titles == ["Task 3", "Task 2", "Task 1"]


def test_get_task_not_found(client):
    resp = client.get("/tasks/999")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    assert resp.json["error"] == "task not found"


def test_get_task_success(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "My Task"})
    task_id = resp.json["id"]
    resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json["title"] == "My Task"
    assert resp.json["status"] == "pending"
    assert resp.json["id"] == task_id


def test_update_task_not_found(client):
    resp = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Nope"})
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    assert resp.json["error"] == "task not found"


def test_update_task_title(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Old Title"})
    task_id = resp.json["id"]
    resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "New Title"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json["title"] == "New Title"
    assert resp.json["status"] == "pending"


def test_update_task_status(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "A Task"})
    task_id = resp.json["id"]
    resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"status": "completed"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json["title"] == "A Task"
    assert resp.json["status"] == "completed"


def test_update_task_both(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Both"})
    task_id = resp.json["id"]
    resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated Both", "status": "done"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json["title"] == "Updated Both"
    assert resp.json["status"] == "done"


def test_update_task_empty_body(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "No Change"})
    task_id = resp.json["id"]
    old = resp.json
    resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json == old


def test_update_task_empty_title(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Real Title"})
    task_id = resp.json["id"]

    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert resp.json["error"] == "title is required"


def test_first_task_id_zero(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "First"})

def test_create_task_default_status_pending(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Check status"})

    assert resp.json["status"] == "pending"


def test_task_fields(client):
    resp = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "Fields"})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    data = resp.json
    assert "id" in data
    assert "title" in data
    assert "status" in data
    assert "created_at" in data
